name: European Grandmothers' Remedies
summary: Raspberry and linden tea, chicken broth, chamomile, blackcurrant and dill from Babcia, Oma and Mormor.

remedies.name: Raspberry Tea
remedies.howItHelps: Warm tea with raspberry preserves is a classic cold drink in Poland and Russia. The warmth and fluids help.
steps: Stir a spoon of raspberry jam into warm tea or water.
Sip and rest under a blanket.

remedies.name: Linden Blossom Tea
remedies.howItHelps: Linden flowers make a soothing warm tea for colds across Europe.
steps: Steep dried linden flowers in hot water.
remedies.caution: Honey is fine for big kids, never for babies under one year.

remedies.name: Chicken Broth
remedies.howItHelps: Warm broth keeps you hydrated, and the steam helps a stuffy nose.
steps: Sip warm broth with carrots and noodles.

remedies.name: Chamomile Tea
remedies.howItHelps: Chamomile relaxes the tummy and helps you rest.
steps: Steep chamomile flowers in hot water.
Cool till warm and sip slowly.

remedies.name: Dill Seed Water
remedies.howItHelps: Dill and fennel seeds are old European remedies for gas bubbles.
steps: Steep a pinch of dill or fennel seeds in hot water.

remedies.name: Warm Blackcurrant Drink
remedies.howItHelps: Blackcurrants are bursting with vitamin C. Nordic families drink them warm when they have a cold.
steps: Stir blackcurrant juice or jam into warm water.

remedies.name: A Glass of Kefir
remedies.howItHelps: Kefir's friendly bacteria help keep a tummy moving.
steps: Drink a small glass of kefir with breakfast.
